$comment: Online catalog of M365 Copilot models, downloaded by the VS Code extension on start and every 12 h (setting m365copilot.models.updateFromCatalog). Add an entry to offer a new model to every user without a release; set "hidden": true to retire one (also for installed versions that ship it). 'tone' is the BizChat tone the web app sends (the browser extension and userscript also detect them automatically). 'name' is shown after 'M365 Copilot · ' — use the web app's own labels. Only list tones seen working: a tone the service knows can still be refused, or answered with a canned reply instead of the model.
